Creates a **new** Zenodo concept record for the P1 living paper (*A machine-checked raster bridge for Trees Cannot
Cut*) at the first weekly publication with a compiled P1 paper, then adds one version per week. Creator: Hart, Justin
(Viridis LLC, ORCID 0009-0008-3082-2482); AI assistance disclosed in the description; linked to the TCC concept DOI
10.5281/zenodo.21686446 as `isSupplementTo`. Zenodo DOIs cannot be deleted. This does **not** touch the existing TCC
record.
title: Create a Zenodo record for project P1
